scenicChapters.title: Grand Tour of Switzerland
scenicChapters.narrative: For 53 km this is Grand Tour of Switzerland, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it — expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.

scenicChapters.title: Emmental Panorama Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 71 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go. Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

grand-tour-of-switzerland-neuchatel-luce.story: A 181 km one-way ride from near Neuchâtel, about 2 h 56 of riding. It goes by way of Bern and Interlaken. The highest point is about 2,000 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.
